final_message:
Implemented `parseSeries`, `MetricsClient`, `evaluateRule` and `findIncidents`. 11 of 12 tests pass. The one failure is `reads the live queue_depth series`, which needs the real metrics service and fails here with `fetch failed` because there's no network.

- `src/series.ts`: validates the body and each sample, throwing `MetricsError` for the cases in the README.
- `src/client.ts`: validates metric name and window (`RangeError` before any request), drops a trailing `/` from `baseUrl`, and maps fetch failures, non-2xx responses and non-JSON bodies to `MetricsError`.
- `src/rules.ts`: validates the rule, then implements the trailing-run logic for `evaluateRule` and the maximal-run logic with peaks for `findIncidents`.

The `apply_patch` tool returned "unsupported call" in this session, so I wrote the three files with shell heredocs. The contents are the same as a patch would produce.

I left `tests/client.test.ts` unchanged. The live test will pass in an environment with access to `metrics.ops.internal`. In CI, you may want to skip it or gate it behind an env var.

I couldn't run `tsc` because `npx` couldn't fetch it (403), so the type-checking is unverified.
